items.title: Cascade (SN91) Just Beat Salesforce’s AI Forecasting Model. It Took 19 Days.
items.body: Cascade beat Salesforce’s Moirai 2.0 on GIFT-Eval CRPS just 19 days into its competition. Here’s how it stacks up against Mistral and Google.

items.title: What Attune (SN58) Does, and How Robotensor Gave Gamma Its First Practical Use Case
items.body: Robotensor’s Attune tests one-shot robot learning in Vector, crowdsources training data through Horizon, and gives Gamma its first use case through data sales.

items.title: Trishool (SN23) to Build Cyber AI Lab, Commit 100% of Profits to Token Buybacks
items.body: Trishool plans a cyber AI lab, combining paid inference and security model training while committing 100% of profits to token buybacks.

items.title: Cascade (SN91)’s Road From Miner Competition to Commercial AI Forecasting
items.body: Explore how Cascade turns miner competitions into AI forecasting models, with Ephemeris bringing financial, retail, and energy forecasts to businesses.

items.title: Subnets Bleed as TAO Investors Retreat to Root
items.body: Bittensor’s subnet market extends its losses as investors shift capital to Root, while Engy defies the downturn with a 31.88% weekly rally.

items.title: Chutes (SN64) Partners With Global Giant Alibaba Cloud
items.body: Chutes partners with Alibaba Cloud to bring Qwen3.8 Max, GLM-5.3 and DeepSeek V4.1 Flash to its platform, with 35% off until Nov 23.
